title: GHK-Cu Facial Serum
description: How to use your 30 mL GHK-Cu Facial Serum, with ingredient information and storage instructions.
imageAlt: WeightPilot GHK-Cu Facial Serum, 30 mL bottle with dropper
frequency: Once daily · Only a thin layer is required

steps.wash: Wash your face and dry it.
steps.apply: Apply approximately 2–4 drops of the serum to your face. You can also apply it to your neck if desired.
steps.wait: Allow approximately 30–60 seconds for the serum to absorb.

copper.name: GHK-Cu — 1%
copper.body: GHK-Cu is a copper peptide studied for its role in skin repair and remodelling, and for supporting processes involved in collagen and elastin production.

ectoin.name: Ectoin — 2%
ectoin.body: Ectoin helps support the skin barrier, hydration and moisture retention. It can help skin feel more comfortable when dry or stressed.

hyaluronic.name: Hyaluronic Acid — 0.3%
hyaluronic.body: Hyaluronic acid attracts and retains water in the skin, helping give it a smoother, more hydrated and plumper appearance.

togetherBody: The formula is deliberately simple, with each main active serving a different purpose.

roles.copper: GHK-Cu: skin repair and remodelling support
roles.ectoin: Ectoin: barrier support and moisture retention

handsTitle: Use on the backs of the hands
handsBody: If there is serum left on your hands after applying it to your face, rub it over the backs of your hands and follow with moisturising cream.
ingredients: Aqua, GHK-Cu, Ectoin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.
preservative: Phenoxyethanol and Ethylhexylglycerin come from the Plantaserve E preservative used in the formulation.

storage.cool: Store in a cool, dry place.
storage.sunlight: Keep away from direct sunlight and excessive heat.

notes.eyes: Avoid direct contact with the eyes.
notes.skin: Do not apply to broken skin.
